tune_invalid.name: tune_invalid
tune_invalid.long_description: The specified encoding tune is invalid or not recognized by the system.

tune_fast.name: fast
tune_fast.long_description: Optimizes encoding for speed over quality, reducing processing time.

tune_balanced.name: balanced
tune_balanced.long_description: Provides a balance between encoding speed and output quality.

tune_high_quality.name: high_quality
tune_high_quality.long_description: Optimizes encoding for maximum output quality, potentially increasing processing time.

tune_low_latency.name: low_latency
tune_low_latency.long_description: Optimizes encoding to minimize latency, suitable for real-time streaming.

tune_zero_latency.name: zero_latency
tune_zero_latency.long_description: Minimizes encoding delay to achieve near-instantaneous output.

tune_lossless.name: lossless
tune_lossless.long_description: Encodes media without any quality loss, preserving the original data.

tune_proxy.name: proxy
tune_proxy.long_description: Generates lower-quality, lower-bitrate files suitable for previews or offline editing.

tune_animation.name: animation
tune_animation.long_description: Optimizes encoding for animated content, improving color and frame handling.

tune_film.name: film
tune_film.long_description: Optimizes encoding for film content, preserving detail and dynamic range.

tune_grain.name: grain
tune_grain.long_description: Preserves film grain and fine details during encoding.

tune_still_image.name: still_image
tune_still_image.long_description: Optimizes encoding for still images or low-motion content.

tune_psnr.name: psnr
tune_psnr.long_description: Optimizes encoding to maximize Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), prioritizing fidelity.

tune_ssim.name: ssim
tune_ssim.long_description: Optimizes encoding to maximize Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), improving perceived visual quality.

tune_texture_compression.name: texture_compression
tune_texture_compression.long_description: Optimizes encoding for texture-rich content, preserving details in patterns and surfaces.

tune_zero_latency_low_latency.name: zero_latency_low_latency
tune_zero_latency_low_latency.long_description: Combines zero latency and low latency optimizations for minimal encoding delay.

tune_default.name: default
tune_default.long_description: Applies the system's default encoding settings.
